newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Feb EU-harmonised CPI rises 0.6 pct - SF. [CORRECTED 07:58 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Finnish Feb EU-harmonised CPI rises 0.6 pct - SF. [CORRECTED 07:58 GMT]

text.p: (Statistics Finland corrects throughout and supplies missing index data for January 1997 and full data for February 1996 as well as missing index points data for the second table (Finnish national CPI).)
index harmonised to European Union standards rose 0.6 percent
year-on-year in February after a 0.7 percent rise in
January, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Friday.
According to SF's regular national method of calculation,
Finnish consumer prices rose 0.1 percent month-on-month in
February and they rose 0.4 percent year-on-year, it said.
